title: Nibs and Fluffernutter
markdown:
Nibs lived in the cozy caves of the Cloudpetal Mountains. When the sun started to get sleepy, the sky turned soft pink and gold. The air smelled sweet, like tiny cloudpetals. Nibs’ little boots made soft thump-thump sounds on the path that wound through the cloud-pine trees. These trees grew so tall their needles tickled the fluffy clouds. Tonight the clouds looked like big scoops of vanilla ice cream, soft and piled high. Nibs liked to pretend he could take a little bite, but he knew he could not.

As Nibs hummed a happy little tune, he heard a quiet shh-shh-shh behind a big fluffy cloud-pine. It sounded like a soft whisper. Nibs stopped humming and peeked around the tree. There, by the mossy roots, was a little creature. It was small, about the size of Nibs’ two hands together. It had fur as white and soft as the clouds. Two big honey-coloured eyes blinked slowly at Nibs. When Nibs took a slow step closer, the creature wiggled its nose and its tail. Squeak-hop.

Nibs’ tummy felt warm and fluttery, like tiny butterflies dancing inside. He smiled a wide gentle smile that crinkled his nose.

“Hello there, little one,” Nibs whispered. “Are you lost?”

The little creature wiggled happily and took a tiny hop closer. It did not seem scared, just curious. Nibs sat down on the soft green moss.

“You can follow me if you like,” he said. “I’m going home to Ogre Grog’s cave for a warm berry bun. It has extra sugary glaze.”

The fluffy creature bounced with delight and began to follow Nibs. Its tiny feet made no sound on the path, like a fluffy white shadow.

They did not hurry the next bend. Nibs sat on a root and let the creature sniff a fallen cloudpetal. One needle ticked a cloud. The creature’s honey eyes stayed on Nibs.

When Nibs reached the warm cozy cave, the fluffy creature peeked around his legs. Inside, the air smelled wonderfully of warm dough and sweet berries. Ogre Grog was stirring a big pot that smelled like ripe berries and cinnamon.

“Well now, Nibs! And who is this little visitor you’ve brought along?” Ogre Grog boomed, his voice rumbling like friendly thunder.

Nibs patted the little creature’s soft head. “This is my new friend,” he said, puffing out his chest a little. “I think I’ll call them Fluffernutter, because they look like a cloud made of fluff!”

Ogre Grog chuckled. “Fluffernutter, eh? A splendid name for something so soft! Here now, have a little bit of bun.”

Ogre Grog put a tiny piece of warm bun on a leaf and offered it to Fluffernutter. The little creature nibbled happily, its nose twitching. Then, with a sigh, it snuggled up against Nibs’ foot, its wiggle turning into a soft purr. Nibs smiled from ear to ear.

The berry bun was shared. The pot kept stirring. Fluffernutter’s purr stayed by Nibs’ boot, and the cave, which had always been cozy, now had one more small quiet in it.
characters: Nibs (young goblin of the Cloudpetal Mountains), Fluffernutter (cloud-soft white creature)
author: StoryGen Community
